subject: ইংরেজি
question: As a Sub-Assistant Maintenance Engineer at the Divisional Passport and Visa Office, draft an official requisition letter to the Central Store Officer requesting the supply of critical consumable hardware items and replacement parts (Thermal Receipt Paper Rolls, RFID Passport Validation Tags, CMOS Batteries, and Cat-6 RJ-45 Connectors).
answer:
Model Official Requisition Letter:

Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh
Department of Immigration and Passports
Divisional Passport and Visa Office, Agargaon, Dhaka.

Memo No: 44.01.2600.004.05.019.26-302
Date: 23 October 2026

To:
The Central Store Officer
Department of Immigration and Passports
Central Warehouse, Agargaon, Dhaka-1207.

Subject: Official Requisition for Consumable IT Hardware and Maintenance Supplies for Q4.

Dear Sir,

I have the honor to state that the current inventory of critical IT consumables and diagnostic hardware at our Divisional Enrollment and Biometric Data Center is nearing exhaustion due to a high volume of citizen applications processed daily. To ensure uninterrupted service delivery and preempt hardware downtime, the following supplies are urgently required for the upcoming quarter:

| Item No. | Description of Supplies | Specification / Model | Required Quantity |
| :---: | :--- | :--- | :---: |
| 1 | Thermal Receipt Paper Rolls | 80mm x 80mm, High-density Grade | 500 Rolls |
| 2 | RFID Validation Test Tags | 13.56 MHz ISO 14443 Type A/B | 200 Units |
| 3 | Lithium Button Cell CMOS Batteries | CR2032 3V (Energizer/Panasonic) | 50 Pieces |
| 4 | Modular RJ-45 Connectors & Boots | Cat-6 UTP Gold-Plated 8P8C | 300 Pieces |
| 5 | Anti-Static Optical Cleaning Wipes | 99% Isopropyl Lint-Free | 20 Packs |

2. It is therefore respectfully requested that you arrange the necessary allocation and issuance of the aforementioned items from the central store at your earliest convenience.

Yours faithfully,

(Signature)
(Md. Asif Mahmud)
Sub-Assistant Maintenance Engineer
Divisional Passport and Visa Office, Dhaka
Phone: +880 2-XXXXXXXX
Email: same.dhaka@dip.gov.bd

Copy forwarded for kind information to:
1. Deputy Director, Divisional Passport and Visa Office, Dhaka.
2. System Analyst, ICT Cell, Department of Immigration and Passports, Dhaka.
3. Office Guard File.
points_to_remember: Include a formatted tabular item list with precise technical specifications and quantities.
Follow standard government memo layout with distribution list.
